correctness.rationale: The exact trigonometric reduction gives a cubic root with coefficient c=-40/sqrt(34*pi). A smooth center graph has w=mu*c*x^3/(1-mu)+O(x^5), giving reduced drift -3*C*mu*c^2*x^5/(1-mu)+O(x^7); telescoping |x|^{-4} yields 9600*C*mu/[17*pi*(1-mu)]. The vertical line is the unique local strong-stable leaf. Fixed points reduce to two explicit quadratics in sin(x)^2, yielding precise +sqrt(epsilon) roots and hyperbolic spectral types. In the time-scaled problem, the memory defect contracts as mu^n+O(epsilon), and Euler consistency plus a compact-interval Gronwall argument proves finite-horizon convergence to the global gradient ODE. The checked standalone symbolic/finite diagnostic program printed VERIFY_OK; finite tests are not the infinite proof. See RESULT.md Proof sections 1-4 and walker_verifier.py.

originality.rationale: The complete new claim is a coupled local singular-shape theorem: sharp critical inverse-fourth relaxation, exact five-versus-one fixed-point split, and a detuning-dependent polynomial gradient scaling limit for the original Gilet wave map. Gilet (2014) already established its fixed point families and plotted shape-dependent branches, so branch counts in isolation are not presented as new. Rahman--Blackmore (2015) considers Neimark--Sacker bifurcations of hyperbolic wave zeros; their formulas do not cover an exactly vanishing wave slope. Their 2017 work concerns distant homoclinic interaction as coupling changes. The closest indexed quintic critical calculations are for different systems; no inspected primary text or indexed claim implies the concrete coupled result. Standard center manifold methods are transparently credited; unknown/unindexed priority remains a limitation, not an assertion of uniqueness.
residual_risks: Generic fifth-order center-manifold asymptotics are established mathematics; the original contribution is the concrete combined critical-shape and detuning-crossover classification, not that exponent in isolation.
Earlier, unindexed studies of precisely this wave-shape cancellation may exist. Independent historical priority assessment has not been performed.
The experimental fluid system is not analyzed, and no conclusions for simultaneous damping limit mu approaching one follow.
The standalone checker contains finite numerical comparisons and cannot verify every initial condition or the asymptotic theorem independently.

value.rationale: The harmonic ratio beta_* is a natural threshold within Gilet's published shape family because its wave excitation slope changes sign and the usual linear hyperbolic analysis loses force. The result gives the exact physical iteration relaxation coefficient at criticality and a resolved transition on spatial scale sqrt(epsilon) and slow time epsilon^{-2}; the limiting gradient process distinguishes three local sinks separated by two saddles from a unique sink. The structure predicts near-collision residence times and basin selection for the specified classical discrete walker toy model. Qualitative fixed-point plots alone, generic center manifold exponents alone, and numerical reproduction alone do not supply this paired exact dynamic limit.
